translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the dynasty, the court promulgated the 《Great Ming Statutes》; the gradations of mourning dress largely followed precedents from earlier ages.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年，《孝慈錄》成，復圖列於《大明令》，刊示中外。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongwu, the 《Record of Filial Kindness》 was completed; it was again charted and listed in the 《Great Ming Statutes》 and published at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of the Hongwu reign, the 《Record of Filial Kindness》 was completed, charted anew in the 《Great Ming Statutes》, and published throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 先是貴妃孫氏薨，敕禮官定服制。

translations.literal: Earlier, Honored Consort Sun died; an edict ordered the ritual officials to fix mourning regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Honored Consort Sun died, the throne ordered the ritual officials to establish mourning regulations.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書牛諒等奏曰：「周《儀禮》，父在，爲母服期年，若庶母則無服。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Niu Liang and others memorialized: "In the Zhou 《Rites of Zhou》, when the father is alive, one wears mourning for one's mother for one year; for a concubine mother there is no mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Niu Liang and others memorialized: "In the Zhou 《Rites of Zhou》, when the father is alive, a son mourns his mother for one year; for a concubine mother he wears no mourning at all.

sentences.zh: 」太祖曰：「父母之恩一也，而低昂若是，不情甚矣。

translations.literal: " The Founder said: "The grace of father and mother is one, yet the high and low are thus—exceedingly unfeeling.
translations.idiomatic: " The Founder said: "The debt owed to father and mother is one and the same, yet to rank them so high and low is deeply unfeeling.

sentences.zh: 」乃敕翰林院學士宋濂等曰；

translations.literal: " He then instructed Hanlin Academy Academician Song Lian and others, saying:
translations.idiomatic: " He then instructed Hanlin Academy Academician Song Lian and others:

sentences.zh: 「養生送死，聖王大政。

translations.literal: "Nourishing life and sending off the dead are the great policies of sage-kings.
translations.idiomatic: "To sustain the living and send off the dead is among the great policies of sage-kings.

sentences.zh: 諱亡忌疾，衰世陋俗。

translations.literal: Tabooing death and shunning illness are the vulgar customs of a decadent age.
translations.idiomatic: To taboo death and dread illness is the shabby custom of a decadent age.

sentences.zh: 三代喪禮散失於衰周，厄於暴秦。

translations.literal: The mourning rites of the Three Dynasties were scattered and lost in the declining Zhou, and crushed under tyrannical Qin.
translations.idiomatic: The mourning rites of the Three Dynasties were scattered in the waning Zhou and crushed under the tyranny of Qin.

sentences.zh: 漢、唐以降，莫能議此。

translations.literal: From Han and Tang downward, none could deliberate on this.
translations.idiomatic: From Han and Tang onward, no one could properly settle the question.

sentences.zh: 夫人情無窮，而禮爲適宜。

translations.literal: For human feeling has no limit, yet ritual must be fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Human feeling knows no bound, yet ritual must be proportionate.

sentences.zh: 人心所安，即天理所在。

translations.literal: Where the human heart finds peace is where the principle of Heaven resides.
translations.idiomatic: Where the heart finds rest is where the principle of Heaven itself lies.

sentences.zh: 爾等其考定喪禮。

translations.literal: You are to investigate and fix the mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: You shall investigate and fix the mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 」於是濂等考得古人論服母喪者凡四十二人，願服三年者二十八人，服期年者十四人。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Song and his colleagues found forty-two ancients who discussed mourning for a mother: twenty-eight wished to mourn three years, fourteen one year.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Song and his colleagues found forty-two ancients who had debated mourning for a mother: twenty-eight favored three years, fourteen one year.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「三年之喪，天下通喪。

translations.literal: The Founder said: "Three years' mourning is the mourning shared throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder said: "Three years' mourning is the mourning observed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 觀願服三年，視願服期年者倍，豈非天理人情之所安乎？

translations.literal: Looking at those who wished three years' mourning—they are double those who wished one year—is this not what the principle of Heaven and human feeling find peace in?
translations.idiomatic: Those who favored three years were twice as many as those who favored one—surely that is what Heaven's principle and human feeling alike find fitting?

sentences.zh: 」乃立爲定制。

translations.literal: " It was then established as fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: " It was then established as fixed law.

sentences.zh: 子爲父母，庶子爲其母，皆斬衰三年。

translations.literal: Sons for parents, secondary sons for their mothers—all cut-edge hemp mourning for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Sons mourning parents, and secondary sons mourning their mothers, all wore cut-edge hemp for three years.

sentences.zh: 嫡子、衆子爲庶母，皆齊衰杖期。

translations.literal: Primary sons and common sons for concubine mothers—all even-hem hemp mourning with staff for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Primary sons and common sons mourning a concubine mother all wore even-hem hemp with staff for one year.

sentences.zh: 仍命以五服喪制，並著爲書，使內外遵寧。

translations.literal: He further ordered the five-fold mourning system, compiled it in a book, and had inner and outer domains observe it.
translations.idiomatic: He further commanded the five-fold mourning system, had it written into a book, and required observance at court and throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 其制服五。

translations.literal: The garments of mourning were five.
translations.idiomatic: There were five grades of mourning garment.

sentences.zh: 曰斬衰，以至粗麻布爲之，不縫下邊。

translations.literal: First, cut-edge hemp: made from the coarsest hemp cloth, the lower edge unsewn.
translations.idiomatic: Cut-edge hemp was made from the coarsest hemp cloth, with the lower hem left unsewn.

sentences.zh: 曰齊衰，以稍粗麻布爲之，縫下邊。

translations.literal: Second, even-hem hemp: made from somewhat coarse hemp cloth, the lower edge sewn.
translations.idiomatic: Even-hem hemp was made from somewhat coarse hemp cloth, with the lower hem sewn.

sentences.zh: 曰大功，以粗熟布爲之。

translations.literal: Third, great mourning: made from coarse processed cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Great mourning was made from coarse processed cloth.

sentences.zh: 曰小功，以稍粗熟布爲之。

translations.literal: Fourth, lesser mourning: made from somewhat coarse processed cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser mourning was made from somewhat coarse processed cloth.

sentences.zh: 曰緦麻，以稍細熟布爲之。

translations.literal: Fifth, finest hemp: made from somewhat fine processed cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Finest hemp was made from somewhat fine processed cloth.

sentences.zh: 其敘服有八。

translations.literal: The ordered mourning categories were eight.
translations.idiomatic: The prescribed mourning categories numbered eight.

sentences.zh: 曰斬衰三年者：子爲父母，庶子爲所生母，子爲繼母，謂母卒父命他妾養己者，子爲養母，謂自幼過房與人者；

translations.literal: Those of cut-edge hemp for three years: a son for parents; a secondary son for his birth mother; a son for a stepmother—meaning where the mother died and the father ordered another concubine to raise him; a son for a foster mother—meaning one given in adoption from childhood;
translations.idiomatic: Cut-edge hemp for three years: a son mourning parents; a secondary son mourning his birth mother; a son mourning a stepmother (when his mother died and his father charged another concubine to raise him); a son mourning a foster mother (when he was given in adoption from childhood);

sentences.zh: 女在室爲父母，女嫁被出而反在室爲父母；

translations.literal: an unmarried daughter for parents; a daughter married, divorced, and returned home unmarried, for parents;
translations.idiomatic: an unmarried daughter mourning parents; a daughter divorced and returned home unmarried, mourning parents;

sentences.zh: 嫡孫爲祖父母承重及曾高祖父母承重者；

translations.literal: the primary grandson bearing principal mourning for grandparents, and for great-great-grandparents when bearing principal mourning;
translations.idiomatic: the primary grandson bearing principal mourning for grandparents, and likewise for great-great-grandparents when he bears the principal obligation;

sentences.zh: 爲人後者爲所後父母，及爲所後祖父母承重；

translations.literal: an heir who has entered another line for the parents of that line, and for the grandparents of that line when bearing principal mourning;
translations.idiomatic: an heir adopted to continue another line, mourning the parents of that line, and likewise the grandparents when he bears the principal obligation;

sentences.zh: 夫爲後則妻從服，婦爲舅姑；

translations.literal: if the husband has become such an heir, the wife follows in mourning; a daughter-in-law for parents-in-law;
translations.idiomatic: if the husband has become an heir to another line, the wife follows his mourning; a daughter-in-law mourning parents-in-law;

sentences.zh: 庶子之妻爲夫之所生母；

translations.literal: the wife of a secondary son for her husband's birth mother;
translations.idiomatic: the wife of a secondary son mourning her husband's birth mother;

sentences.zh: 妻妾爲夫。

translations.literal: wife and concubines for the husband.
translations.idiomatic: wife and concubines mourning the husband.

sentences.zh: 曰齊衰杖期者：嫡子衆子爲庶母；

translations.literal: Those of even-hem hemp with staff for one year: primary and common sons for concubine mother;
translations.idiomatic: Even-hem hemp with staff for one year: primary and common sons mourning a concubine mother;

sentences.zh: 嫡子衆子之妻爲夫之庶母，爲嫁母、出母、父卒繼母改嫁而已從之者；

translations.literal: wives of primary and common sons for the husband's concubine mother, for a remarried mother, for a divorced mother, and for a stepmother who remarried after the father's death when they had followed her;

translations.idiomatic: a concubine mourning her own parents;

sentences.zh: 祖爲嫡孫；

translations.literal: Those of even-hem hemp for five months: for great-grandparents.
translations.idiomatic: Even-hem hemp for five months: mourning great-grandparents.

sentences.zh: 爲人後者爲本生外祖父母。

translations.literal: heir who entered another line for birth maternal grandparents.
translations.idiomatic: an heir adopted to continue another line, mourning his birth maternal grandparents.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十八年正月，諭輔臣：「昨居喪理疾，閱《禮記·檀弓》等篇，其所著禮儀制度俱不歸一，又不載天子全儀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year of Jiajing, he instructed the senior ministers: "Yesterday, while in mourning and tending to affairs, I read the 《Book of Rites: Tan Gong》 and other chapters; the ritual protocols and institutions they set forth are all inconsistent, and they do not record the emperor's full protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighteenth year of the Jiajing reign, the emperor instructed his senior ministers: "Yesterday, while in mourning and attending to state affairs, I read the 《Book of Rites: Tan Gong》 and related chapters. The rites and institutions they describe are inconsistent with one another, and they do not set forth the emperor's full protocol.

sentences.zh: 雖曰『三年之喪，通乎上下』，而今昔亦有大不同者。

translations.literal: Although it says 'three years' mourning extends through high and low,' past and present also differ greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Though it is said that 'three years' mourning extends through high and low alike,' past and present differ greatly nonetheless.

sentences.zh: 皇祖所定，未有全文，每遇帝后之喪，亦未免因仍爲禮。

translations.literal: What the imperial grandfather fixed lacks a complete text; whenever emperors or empresses die, one cannot but follow precedent as ritual.
translations.idiomatic: What the imperial grandfather established survives only in fragments; whenever an emperor or empress dies, the court can hardly avoid falling back on precedent.

sentences.zh: 至於冠裳衰絰，所司之制不一，其與禮官考定之。

translations.literal: As for caps, garments, mourning bands, and staff—the regulations of the responsible offices are not uniform; have them investigated and fixed with the ritual officials.
translations.idiomatic: As for caps, garments, mourning bands, and staff, the offices charged with these matters follow inconsistent rules. Let them work with the ritual officials to investigate and fix them.

sentences.zh: 自初喪至除服，冠裳輕重之制具爲儀節，俾歸至當。

translations.literal: From first mourning to dismissal of garments, fully prescribe the protocol for the light and heavy gradations of caps and garments, so that all may return to what is most fitting.
translations.idiomatic: From the first days of mourning to the laying aside of garments, fully prescribe the gradations of caps and dress from lightest to heaviest, so that every stage may be brought to what is right.

sentences.zh: 」於是禮部議喪服諸制奏之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Ministry of Rites deliberated on the various mourning-garment regulations and memorialized them.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon the Ministry of Rites deliberated on the various mourning regulations and memorialized its findings.

sentences.zh: 帝令更加考訂，畫圖註釋，並祭葬全儀，編輯成書備覽。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered further investigation and revision, illustrated diagrams with annotations, and the full protocol for sacrifice and burial, compiled into a book for reference.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered further revision, illustrated diagrams with annotations, and the full protocol for sacrifice and burial, all compiled into a book for his review.
